title: Paul McCartney live at El Capitan Outdoor Stage, Los Angeles (Jimmy Kimmel Live)
content:
Paul McCartney performed a 15-song set at the El Capitan Outdoor Stage on Hollywood Boulevard, Los Angeles.

The show was a filmed concert for the Jimmy Kimmel Live television show. Two songs from the set, Lady Madonna and New, were shown during the broadcast, and the complete concert was streamed online.

Concert setlist

  • ‘Magical Mystery Tour’
  • ‘Save Us’
  • ‘Junior’s Farm’
  • ‘Jet’
  • ‘New’
  • ‘Lady Madonna’
  • ‘Birthday’
  • ‘Another Day’
  • ‘Everybody Out There’
  • ‘Ob-La-Di, Ob-La-Da’
  • ‘Band On The Run’
  • ‘Back In The USSR’
  • ‘Day Tripper’
  • ‘Let It Be’
  • ‘Hey Jude’
Page last updated: 29 October 2013
